_comment: The Duke's order (systems.md 6.5, docs/living-city.md section 5): one city-wide order at a time that every player can contribute to. Orders run in this list's order, then start over. Each line's goal is multiplied by max(1, active crafters in the last 7 days / players_per_goal_step), up to max_goal_scale. A contribution pays pay_multiplier x the item's usual value per unit at once; when every line is filled, contributors get bonus_multiplier x usual value per unit they gave. pay_multiplier + bonus_multiplier must stay below market.ceiling_multiplier (the 0.5.1 supplier rule; the validator checks it). One player can fill at most max_share of a line until open_share_after of the order's time has passed; then anyone can finish it. duration_hours scales with the game's pace. Every number is [tune].

orders.title: Lights and supplies for the Regatta fleet
orders.line: By order of His Grace the Duke: every galley in the Regatta shall carry a lantern, a draught for the oarsmen and a satchel for the captain's charts.

orders.title: Arm the city watch
orders.line: The Duke's watch walks the walls at night. They need blades, tonic against the cold, and stout jerkins.

orders.title: The Ospedale of Santa Lucia
orders.line: The Duke endows the hospital by the harbor. Fra Amon will gladly take lanterns for the wards, draughts and satchels for the healers.

orders.title: A feast at the Palazzo Ducale
orders.line: Ambassadors arrive from the Levant. The palazzo must glitter: lanterns along the loggia, lemon tonic for the toasts, fine satchels as gifts.
